title: Grid disturbance resilience and stability improvement of grid-connected wind power plants
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,1038-1061
DOI: 10.1039/D4SE00683F, Paper
Ali Q. Al-Shetwi
This study develops an integrated control strategy for grid-connected wind power plants (GCWPPs) to address voltage and frequency stability challenges during disturbances, enabling them to operate similarly to conventional power stations.
